title: Classic Burger Bowl Salad with Special Burger Sauce
ingredients: 1 lb extra-lean ground turkey, seasoned with garlic powder, onion powder, Worcestershire, salt & pepper
6 cups crisp Romaine or iceberg lettuce, chopped
Light Burger Sauce: 3 tbsp Greek yogurt, 1 tbsp light mayo, 1.5 tbsp sugar-free ketchup, 1 tsp yellow mustard, 1 tbsp pickle juice
instructions: Form seasoned ground turkey into 4 burger patties (or crumble-sear in a cast-iron skillet) and cook 4–5 minutes per side until caramelized and cooked through.
Whisk together the Greek yogurt, light mayo, ketchup, mustard, and dill pickle brine for the tangy burger sauce.
Layer crisp lettuce, tomatoes, cucumber, red onion, dill pickles, and cheddar in bowls, top with the sliced hot turkey burgers, and drizzle with burger sauce.
